reference.format: n*dim int8 (row-major) followed by n float32 little-endian per-row scales; row = int8*scale, then L2-normalise. Query: L2-normalise the embedding; distance = 1 - mean of the k largest cosine similarities.

ood.local_nearest_rule: A photo also counts as familiar when officer-labelled rows exist (labelled on this phone or received in an officer update; never reference rows) and 1 - cosine similarity to the single nearest of them <= local_nearest_cutoff.

route_to_officer_note: Classes listed here are never shown as a diagnosis: when one is the top class, the photo goes to the officer ("looks like a different problem").
trained_on: JMuBEN+JMuBEN2 (Kenya, Kirinyaga; 1,500 sampled per class) + half of BRACOL (Brazil) + 1303 RoCoLe field photos (Ecuador, robusta, on-plant; 751 healthy, 552 rust) + 154 RoCoLe red-spider-mite photos as 'other'. Not trained on: 60 human-baseline photos, 7 demo samples (one is a mite photo), copies of those, and copy groups that carry two different labels.
calibrated_on: held-out half of BRACOL + out-of-fold predictions for the training field photos (5-fold)
